summary: General Reports gain a shared period/model/operation builder, interrupted backups recover automatically, and projects can register local fonts and themes.
highlights: A backup whose worker dies is now detected, failed with a reason, and retried instead of staying 'running' forever.
Backup progress reports records, files, and encrypted bytes, plus how long ago the run last reported anything.
General Reports share quarter, half-year, year, custom range, model, and operation selections across the page, XLSX, and ZIP.
DLUX_CUSTOM_FONTS merges project-owned font variants into the existing typography settings and runtime.
DLUX_CUSTOM_THEMES merges validated project-owned static CSS themes into the existing theme controls and runtime.
Model-backed sidebar sections and groups show live per-user unread counters behind a separate Sidebar toggle.
